thread.title: Your first trade for Tuesday, August 28

author: Nia Warfield
title: Your first trade for Tuesday, August 28
text:
The " Fast Money " traders shared their first moves for the market open.
Tim Seymour was a buyer of the MSCI Germany ETF
Brian Kelly was a buyer of the VanEck Oil Services ETF
Steve Grasso was a buyer of Ford
Guy Adami was a buyer of Marathon Oil
